title: ASP.NET Core Auth: Secure Your APIs

scenes.say: Do you know how authentication and authorization work together to secure your ASP.NET Core APIs?

scenes.label: Auth
scenes.sub: Authentication checks who you are. JWT Bearer is common.
scenes.say: First up is authentication. This verifies user identity. JWT Bearer tokens are a popular method in ASP.NET Core.

scenes.label: Authz
scenes.sub: Authorization controls what you can access.
scenes.say: Next is authorization. This decides what the authenticated user can actually do. Use roles, claims, or policies for fine-grained control.
Set up authentication before authorization in your Program or Startup file. Add policies for flexible rules.

scenes.question: Can you swap auth and authz middleware?
scenes.right: No. Authentication must run before authorization or access checks will fail.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: Middleware order matters. Authentication must run before authorization. Get this wrong, and your access checks will break.
